<?php
class ScopeBase238 { public function __invoke($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope238 extends ScopeBase238 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable(new self))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable(new parent))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:(\Closure::fromCallable(new static))(true)); } } class ScopeChild238 extends Scope238 { public function __invoke($value) { echo "CHILD/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class ScopeMagic238 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic238; ScopeChild238::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift238() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase238 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function __invoke($first,$ignored) { echo "INVOKE;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope238 extends PacketBase238 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable(new static(7)))(true,shift238())); } } class PacketChild238 extends PacketScope238 {}
class Owner238 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner238; $child = PacketChild238::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild238 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StopBase238 { public function __invoke() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "INVOKE;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class StopScope238 extends StopBase238 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable(new parent))(),later238()); } } class StopChild238 extends StopScope238 {}
function later238() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic238 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic238; $result = 0; try { $result = StopChild238::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
